nav: N7 brutal slab, three-item page nav (was one .slab__to cross-link)
findings: a third page made the cross-link's premise false: .slab__to said 'the other page' and there were now two of them, with no way to reach the third from the second; it also carried no current-page state at all, so the bar never told you where you were; and at 22px tall it sat under the 24x24 WCAG 2.5.8 floor while sharing the bar with 44px stamps
fixed: one .slab__to became a .slab__pages group of three with aria-current=page on the live one; the current-page cue is the bottom rule going --rule-hair -> --rule-slab, a 6x step, with ink-dim -> ink second and never colour alone; min-height:var(--tap) via inline-flex, the .slab__mark technique, which also lands all three underlines on one y so the group reads as a group; arrows dropped, since they encoded a direction that only means something between exactly two pages; .slab__to moved out of the finance section of page.css into the nav section so it is declared once; page.css's pre-JS --topbar-h fallback re-measured 204px -> 290px; .slab itself untouched - still three flex children, still space-between
measured: wordmark 214.4px on veso and 249.3px on y2k, page group 182.6-209.0px, so one row needs 20 + wordmark + 12 + group + 20 and the widest skin governs: floors bisected to 1px are veso 461, thantai 420, viahe 397, y2k 484, each agreeing with its own arithmetic sum within a pixel, so 484px replaces the old 360px; stamps rejoin that row at 797px, giving three slab states; the page group never wraps internally - checked at 280, 300, 320, 360, 375, 390, 414, 430 in four skins, zero cases; contrast by canvas readback because getComputedStyle returns oklch verbatim - non-current 4.84 worst, current 8.79 worst, hover 4.62 worst, the rule itself 4.77 worst against the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11, every link 44px tall in every skin; topbar height max 290px at y2k/280px over 14 widths x 4 skins x 3 pages; zero horizontal overflow across the same grid, checked by element rects because overflow-x:clip makes scrollWidth blind
deferred: the extra slab row costs up to 86px of sticky viewport, and every live phone width now pays it where before only 320px did. Not fixable without dropping a page link or hiding the nav behind a toggle, and a hidden nav is worse than a tall one
brief: third page - the two-page cross-link has to become a real page nav

findings: four competing left axes in one block: a 70ch prose measure inside a 1060px wrap, a 12px dd indent, no rule tying the column heads together, and 5-vs-3 items leaving the second column short
fixed: deleted .colophon__made and .colophon__block (the 70ch measure) and moved their content into a third column of the same <h2> + <dl> shape; dropped dd padding-left so each column has one left axis; hairline under every h2 as the grid cue and, when stacked, the section divider; new full-width .colophon__base; footer links inline-block for a 29.8px tap target (WCAG 2.5.8 AA); tai-chinh.html footer was missing .wrap entirely and bled to the viewport edge - now on the same system
measured: longest credit dt 329.5px unwrapped; even 3-col gives 318.66px and wraps it, 1.25fr 1fr 1fr gives 367.69px and does not; breakpoint swept in 8px steps - 960px still wraps at 329.2px, 968px clears at 332.3px, so 900 -> 980; verified across 15 widths x 4 skins x 2 pages, zero horizontal overflow
deferred: at 320-360px the longest credit still wraps - the column is 280-320px and the string needs 329.5px, so it cannot fit. It breaks at a hyphen (xsmb- / analysis), not mid-word, so it is left alone
brief: footer looks messy - alignment is all over the place
